author: Christian Birzer
name: HeliconFocus
description: Exports a selected group to the commercial Helicon Focus app for focus stacking and re-imports the combined result.
description-extensive: Adds a panel that sends a set of selected photos to the commercial Helicon Focus program (which you must buy and install) to combine them into one fully-sharp focus-stacked image, then brings the result back into darktable.
